definitions.explanation: The amount of money spent on food, whether for a household, organization, or specific period.

examples.japanese: {食料費|しょくりょうひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to save on food expenses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食料費|しょくりょうひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えて→超える：01942_koeru⟧しまった。
examples.english: This month's food expenses exceeded the budget.

examples.japanese: ⟦{物価|ぶっか}→物価：03607_bukka⟧⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}→上昇：11296_joushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食料費|しょくりょうひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Due to rising prices, household food costs are increasing year by year.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧ (food; provisions) and ⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ (expense; cost). Used in household budgeting, economics, and organizational accounting. Often discussed in the context of rising prices and household savings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食料費|しょくりょうひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}する→節約する：25226_setsuyakusuru⟧: to save on food expenses
- {食料費|しょくりょうひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧: to hold down food costs
- ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食料費|しょくりょうひ}: monthly food expenses
- {食料費|しょくりょうひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: food costs rise
- ⟦{家計|かけい}→家計：12287_kakei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食料費|しょくりょうひ}: household food expenses

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{食費|しょくひ}→食費：16477_shokuhi⟧: food expenses — more common in everyday conversation and essentially synonymous, though {食料費|しょくりょうひ} sounds slightly more formal
- ⟦{生活費|せいかつひ}→生活費：19424_seikatsuhi⟧: living expenses — broader category that includes food, rent, utilities, and other costs
- {食材費|しょくざいひ}: ingredient costs — specifically the cost of cooking ingredients, often used in restaurant contexts
